summary.text: Bountiful Year is a time path immortal killer move from Hei Fan's true inheritance. It is used to develop the immortal aperture.

claims.text: Among more than thirty time path immortal killer moves in Hei Fan’s true inheritance, Fang Yuan fixes on this one. The core is immortal level year Gu, with tens of thousands of supplementary mortal Gu. Activation is a tough process. Even Hei Fan needed two or three days of preparation to execute it, and the immortal essence expenditure is huge. For the next year from the moment of successful activation, all resources inside the immortal aperture are produced at a higher rate. Hei Fan praises it greatly and notes that he is not the creator: he exchanged for it with a person called Pill Immortal. Preparing it would require buying many mortal Gu from treasure yellow heaven. Fang Yuan also needs to parallel refine his year Gu, which is only a little over the hundred year level, or it could fall to a mortal Gu.

Fang Yuan activates it after laying dragon scale soil and isolating a special sea area in Mini Eastern Sea for his dragonfish group. Hei Fan did not create the move; he traded for it with a Gu Immortal great expert named Pill Immortal. It has no offensive ability.

The version Fang Yuan uses has been modified. The original core remains year Gu, but he adds rank seven perseverance Immortal Gu as the first supplementary Gu worm. Activation takes more than ten days, approaching half a month, longer than Hei Fan’s two or three days, because Fang Yuan’s time path attainment is still ordinary. The activation succeeds with no backlash. Perseverance doubles the duration from one year to two years and saves a portion of red date immortal essence, but it also reduces the effective range. The effect covers the dragon scale sea area and a vast range of its surroundings, yet only a portion of Mini Eastern Sea. Covering the whole sovereign immortal aperture is not possible. Adding perseverance Immortal Gu along with day Immortal Gu could raise the effect further, but that is beyond his time path attainment at this time.
